QUATERNARY (NINTH-ORDER) SPHERICAL ABERRATION
----------------------------------------------------------------
Buchdahl's q1p, in the units of his paper IV Table I: the scheme runs at unit
focal length and nothing here rescales. INTRINSIC is what the surface makes on
its own; TOTAL adds what it makes by acting on the aberration already reaching
it. The system figure is the sum of the TOTAL column.

Surf          intrinsic            total        T1-dagger
1            6.4168E+03       6.4168E+03       0.0000E+00
2           -1.6196E-01       5.6838E+03       7.2939E+02
3            1.8945E+00      -1.9043E+02      -1.7177E+03
4           -2.5600E+03       5.0847E+03      -5.3386E+01
5            0.0000E+00       0.0000E+00       2.2071E+03
6           -8.4690E+04      -6.1982E+04       2.3400E+02
7           -3.4479E-02       1.5108E+03      -4.7829E+02
8           -2.3324E-03       4.5975E+03       9.8941E+03
9            3.3805E+04       8.0841E+04       7.4291E+02
---------------------------------------------------------
TOTAL                         4.1963E+04

Buchdahl's rule of thumb, from the closing paragraph of paper IV: a system
intended to work at f/2 should aim at individual contributions of at most
order 1000 at unit focal length. His own triplet runs to six figures, which
is why he chose it - it is a poorly corrected system and the table shows it.
